annotations.title: utilpeek: check the format and check digits of an IBAN, VAT, ISBN or other ID

description: utilpeek: check the format and check digits of an identifier. For a VIN's vehicle use decode_vin; for phone numbers use parse_phone_number. Returns `valid`, `reason` (invalid_checksum, invalid_length, invalid_format, ... when not valid), `compact`, `formatted` and a kind-specific `detail` (an IBAN's country and bank code, an ISBN's ISBN-10/13 forms, ...). An invalid identifier is a normal answer (charged); a malformed request is a 422 (not charged). Checks format and check digits only, offline (python-stdnum): a valid result does not mean the identifier exists or is registered (no registry, bank or VIES call). Payment card numbers are not accepted, not even under `luhn`. The submitted value is processed in memory only, never logged or stored. Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/iban-validation-api.html

kind.description: Identifier kind: iban, bic, vat (EU, format only, no VIES), isbn, issn, ean, isin, lei, imo, luhn (generic mod-10), or a national format (au_abn, br_cnpj, br_cpf, ca_bn, ch_uid, de_idnr, es_nif, fr_siren, fr_siret, gb_vat, in_pan, mx_rfc, nl_bsn, us_ein). No payment card numbers.
